answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making each identity stake a refundable deposit that scales with the trust it claims — a lantern of earned reputation, not a cheap badge. A newcomer starts at the nadir: no stake, no attestation, only low-value jobs at the jetty, where every task is metered and verified. Forging a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes, and slashing burns the deposit of any identity caught lying. Honest agents climb as stake and history compound; attackers pay per identity while upside stays capped, so mass fakery becomes unprofitable.
